schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: STAGE 4 OF THE CHART CHAIN, and a machine of its own since 2026-08-13. It answers ONE narrow question — how does this request SPLIT? — and emits the smallest typed artifact that fully determines what the next stage needs. Turns one bounded, surveyed request into the pieces a build can actually take one at a time. Three strata, cheapest first: FLOOR (deterministic, this module), TREE (this nexus's own corpus through cairn/tools/tree), CEILING (the skill's assembly). The exit artifact berths in instance-space and the deposit-back lands it as the tree's memory of this class of request.
why: Akien, verbatim 2026-08-13: "orient is a machine. the other pre-build steps are each their own machine." A machine is tools plus the glue that holds them together, and that is exactly the shape here: cairn/tools/chain's grammar plus this stage's own question. THE LIVED SYMPTOM the whole chain answers is a build that starts before anyone settled what was being built — the web-server carrier miss (2026-07-28), bounds-checking that never ran to completion. A stage that is its own machine can be fired, proved, and replaced alone; one that is a function in a 1,300-line module cannot.
invoke: fired by the skill that runs the chain; the writer door is write_decompose
entry: Carved out of the chart machine on 2026-08-13 under Akien's ruling — "chart is a skill, it calls a collection of machines. that's the intention." The chart charter it was carved from is the design record of the whole chain and now berths with the skill at cairn/skills/chart/intention+why.json; this file holds only what is THIS component's.
state_and_history: state.json + history.json beside this charter. Both were born at the carve-out: the voyages that built this stage are recorded in the chart machine's history, which stays whole with the skill — a record of truth is never split (Law 7).
gates: the stage's own validate_* door, which accumulates EVERY shape lack and raises once (ticket chart-doors-refuse-in-one-pass); the shared checks come from cairn/tools/chain's common_shape_lacks so the seven doors cannot drift apart.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) this stage reading its input from anywhere but the previous stage's BERTHED packet; (2) a door that dribbles refusals instead of naming every lack in one pass; (3) a packet admitted whose provenance does not cover every authored field; (4) this module importing a sibling stage — the legs speak the grammar, never each other.
horizon: re-read when the chain's stage list changes, or when this stage's tree stratum goes live against a real embed seam.
how_it_learns: the deposit-back: every ceiling assembly deposits its own answer into this nexus's tree, so the next similar request walks to a settled answer instead of re-deriving it (Law 1 as runtime). The dial (cairn/skills/chart/dial.py) is the instrument that says whether the floor+tree fraction is actually growing — a nexus that never compiles is a ceiling doing the floor's job forever.
traces_to: Law 1 (the preamble compiled; the resolver spent on the novel)
Law 3 (per-field provenance and confidence; nothing claimed unmeasured)
Law 4 (the door is physics, not a habit of asking)
Law 5 (charter, state, history and proofs share this address)
owner: CC owns this module's code and proofs and gates writes to them. Akien owns the ruling that made it a machine (2026-08-13) and the chain's stage vocabulary.
